tools.description: Searches code snippets of CAP documentation for the given query. You MUST use this tool if you're unsure about CAP APIs for CDS, Node.js or Java. Optionally returns only code blocks.

tools.description: Returns CDS model definitions (CSN), including elements, annotations, parameters, file locations and HTTP endpoints. Useful for building queries, OData URLs, or modifying models.

namesOnly.description: If true, only return definition names (for overview)
